ModMetaData.name: Witcher Monster Quests
ModMetaData.author: Tristan
ModMetaData.description:
Monster contracts and contract beasts for RimWorld colonies.
Take hunt jobs from random world quests or settlement caravans ("Browse witcher contracts"). Villagers describe attacks in vague, contradictory terms — the real beast is only revealed at the site. Rewards may be silver, faction goodwill, or the Law of Surprise (a delayed gift within a week).
Includes the leshen — a dormant forest spirit that stirs when intruders draw near, then teleports through the trees and fights at range with Gorehulk-style spine launches and wolf summons.
Optional Dark Ages encounter pools load when Van.Beasts is active. Optional VRE-Sanguophage encounter pools load when Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage is active.
